# 半监督学习：该章节基础示例
import numpy as np
from sklearn.semi_supervised import SelfTrainingClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
X=rng.normal(size=(50,3));y=(X[:,0]>0).astype(int)
y[15:]=-1
m=SelfTrainingClassifier(LogisticRegression(),threshold=.8).fit(X,y)
print("Predictions:",m.predict(X[-5:]))

# 平方误差MSE：该章节基础示例
import numpy as np
y=np.array([0.,1.,1.,0.]);score=np.array([.2,.9,.8,.1])
mse=np.mean((score-y)**2)
ce=-np.mean(y*np.log(score)+(1-y)*np.log(1-score))
res=np.array([-.2,.3,-2.,1.])
huber=np.where(abs(res)<=1,res**2/2,abs(res)-.5)
print("MSE/CE/Huber:",mse,ce,huber.mean())
